notes.title: Remote Play, TOGETHER!
notes.notes:
Attention all adventurers, heroes, and villains alike! We're thrilled to announce the release of our highly-anticipated multiplayer demo for Big Boss: A Villain Simulator, now available exclusively for the Remote Play Together event on Steam this week! But that's not all—connect with fellow players and coordinate epic battles by joining our vibrant Discord community!

Prepare to embark on an epic journey like never before as you step into the shoes of The Revenant, a formidable boss lurking deep within the treacherous confines of a sinister dungeon. Armed with fiery powers and insatiable malevolence, The Revenant stands as the ultimate challenge for any brave soul daring enough to cross their path.

But fear not, for you and your comrades-in-arms can band together in a daring quest to thwart evil and emerge victorious! Choose from three distinct classes, each with its own unique abilities and strengths: the mighty Swordsman, the wise Cleric, or the enigmatic Wizard. With seamless offline play support, the bonds of friendship and camaraderie know no bounds as you and your companions forge new alliances and face the darkness head-on.

Join us for a week-long celebration of multiplayer mayhem and immersive gaming experiences with the Remote Play Together event on Steam! Download the demo now and experience the thrill of cooperative gameplay, epic boss battles, and unforgettable fights in Big Boss: A Villain Simulator. And don't miss out on the chance to join the excitement and connect with fellow adventurers on Discord. Share strategies, form alliances, and fight with, or against, each other! The fate of the realm hangs in the balance—will you rise to the challenge or succumb to the darkness? The choice is yours!
